title: The LED Light Therapy Trend Is Getting Bigger, Literally. These Full-Body Devices Cover More Than Just Your Face
summary: With prices starting at $1,169, these full-body LED light therapy devices go beyond glowing skin to target everything from hair growth and chronic pain to inflammation and wound recovery.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

LED light therapy is having a serious moment. From BeautyTok skincare routines to celebrity wellness trends, these glowing gadgets are becoming the must-have beauty- tech devices to add to self-care routines. And they’re about more than just getting a radiant complexion. LED (light-emitting diode) therapy uses specific wavelengths of light to stimulate cells in the skin and body, potentially helping with everything from collagen production to cognitive function.

In fact, according to UCLA Health , red-light therapy may help with a whole host of issues, such as reducing signs of aging, stimulating hair growth, tackling acne, improving cognition, and easing chronic pain. So why limit your light therapy to your face? Full-body LED devices make it possible to target multiple areas at once, and with holiday deals already in full swing, now is the time to add a full-body LED device to your Christmas shopping list while discounts last.

BEST RED-LIGHT PANEL OVERALL

Helio Nova by Helio Cure

Editor’s Pick

$4,999 $5,999 17% off

Buy Now at helio cure

– 864 LEDs for extensive head-to-toe coverage
– Seven modes
– Red and near-infrared light
– Three-year warranty and 60-day home trial
– Loved for its multiple positioning options

The Helio Nova is a standout for anyone who wants to treat their entire body without constantly moving or repositioning a panel. Helio Cure positions its device as offering the industry’s highest LED density at 1064nm, a wavelength designed to target deeper tissue penetration and built to support everything from smoother skin and hair growth to pain relief and recovery. Customers appreciate its versatility, noting that the whole family can enjoy its full-body benefits while exercising, working at a desk or relaxing on the couch in one of its several positions. The Helio Nova does not include blue-light therapy, which is known to help minimize acne but may also disrupt sleep. This is a trade-off worth considering based on your individual needs.

BEST MODULAR SETUP

Mito Pro+ Series 1500+

$1,169

Buy Now at mito red light

– Combines red and near-infrared light
– Three treatment settings
– Remote control and built-in timer
– Can be expanded with additional panels for greater coverage

Want a device that can grow with your wellness routine? The MitoPRO 1500+ is a versatile panel that lets you choose between red light, near-infrared light or both together. Red light is commonly used for skin-focused treatments, while near-infrared light reaches deeper into the body. It also comes with hanging hardware, so you can start using it without buying a separate stand. Reviewers boast about how it’s super easy to set up and use despite its size and advanced technology.

BEST INTENSITY SETTINGS

Total Spectrum Elite

$4,395 $4,995 12% off

Buy Now at rlt home

– 864 LEDs and seven light wavelengths
– Includes an electric stand for easy positioning
– Nine modes
– Custom intensity settings

If you’re looking for a device that offers plenty of ways to personalize your routine, the Total Spectrum Elite deserves a spot on your list. Its seven wavelengths combine blue, red and different types of infrared light to target a range of concerns. For example, blue light is used for acne-prone skin, red light supports collagen production and near-infrared light reaches deeper tissues. The electric stand also makes it easier to adjust the panel for full-body sessions. Customers praise RLT Home’s customer service for offering personal recommendations on which LED light therapy to use from its nine modes.

BEST FULL-BODY BLANKET

Hooga Health's Red Light Full-Body Blanket

$1,399

Buy Now at hooga health

– 2,680 LED beads across the front and back
– Unzips flat into a blanket or zips closed into a wraparound bag
– Adjustable brightness, treatment time and light settings

For anyone who prefers to be wrapped up during their wellness routine, the Hooga Full Body Blanket makes light therapy feel a little more like a spa treatment. It features 2,680 LED beads that deliver red and near-infrared light across both sides of the body. You can lay it open and flat for targeted sessions or zip it closed for more all-around coverage, all without needing a standing panel. Customers love that it’s easy to store when not in use.

BEST FULL-BODY MAT

HigherDOSE's Full-Body Red-Light Mat

$1,199

Buy Now at higherdose

– Combines red light and near-infrared light
– Optional pulsing setting for near-infrared light
– Can be laid flat or hung vertically
– Multiple session lengths to suit your routine

The HigherDOSE Full-Body Red-Light Mat is a great option for anyone who wants flexibility without a complicated setup. Customers enjoy its lightweight design, which allows you to lay it flat for a relaxing session or hang it vertically when you want to use it standing up. It combines red and near-infrared light to support skin health, muscle recovery and relaxation, making it an easy addition to your daily wellness routine.

With LED light therapy continuing to gain popularity, it’s easy to see why these full-body devices are becoming the next big thing in at-home wellness. From supporting smoother-looking skin and healthier hair to helping with muscle recovery and everyday aches, there’s plenty to explore beyond the traditional facial mask. Consider it your head-to-toe excuse to get glowing.
